description: Separate consent flows for unknown questions vs contact-me requests. Each stream has different de-identification and storage rules.

stream_1_unknown_questions.trigger: User asks a question the system cannot answer
flow: System asks: 'May I record your question so we can improve? We would save a de-identified version of this conversation.'
If yes: de-identify chat history ALWAYS (no verbatim option), store question + de-identified history
If no: do not store question or history
Either way: offer follow-up from ChatHealthy team
stream_1_unknown_questions.de_identification: Always. No verbatim option for unknown questions.

stream_2_contact_me.trigger: User wants someone from ChatHealthy to follow up
flow: PHI warning: 'This conversation may contain personal health information. ChatHealthy is not a HIPAA covered entity.'
User chooses: 'Would you like us to save the full verbatim transcript, or would you prefer we de-identify it first?'
If verbatim: store full raw chat history with consent_verbatim=true
If de-identify: run deIdentify, store scrubbed version with consent_verbatim=false, consent_summary=true
If neither: store contact fields only, no history

bugs_found.bug: Sonnet set consent_verbatim=true when user explicitly asked for de-identification
bugs_found.root_cause: System prompt consent instructions not specific enough about mapping user response to consent flags

bugs_found.bug: PII not scrubbed in stored chat history when de-identify was requested
bugs_found.root_cause: consent_verbatim=true overrode de-identification — deIdentify was never called
